description: Finish 6.0 Phase 25 — live-ready Stripe/checkout catalog ops refresh for nest cosmetics (≥31 active / ≥30 cosmetics). Secrets never committed.
cutoverChecklist: Every active SKU has stripePriceId placeholder or STRIPE_PRICE_* override
Live without STRIPE_SECRET_KEY returns 503 (no sandbox fallback)
Webhook signature verify + idempotent replay of same event id
Stripe Dashboard webhook endpoint points at POST /v1/stripe/webhook
Replace price_test_* placeholders with live price ids before production traffic
stripeops6:validate green; soft stripeops5:validate still green

manualOps.title: Sync store catalogs
manualOps.body: Run python3 shared/tools/author_stripe_ops_6.py then npm run billing:validate after adding nest cosmetics. Mirrors entitlements into Play/web/checkout product tables.

manualOps.title: Map live Stripe prices
manualOps.body: Create Stripe Prices for each webProductId, then set stripePriceId or STRIPE_PRICE_<SKU> env overrides. Never commit live secret keys.

manualOps.title: Cut over to live mode
manualOps.body: Set CHECKOUT_API_MODE=live with STRIPE_SECRET_KEY + STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET. Confirm /v1/ops/readiness liveReady=true and finish6CatalogOk=true before traffic.

manualOps.title: Refund verify
manualOps.body: After a Stripe refund, confirm GET /v1/entitlements no longer returns the SKU for that cloudAccountId (or re-reconcile per entitlement-reconcile.json).

manualOps.title: Finish 5 catalog drift audit (soft)
manualOps.body: Diff entitlements.json cosmetics vs web-checkout-products.json for Finish 5 floors (≥24). Soft-floor stays green under Finish 6 sync.

manualOps.title: Finish 6 nest catalog drift audit
manualOps.body: Diff entitlements.json nest cosmetics (saffron/cobalt/roast/ferment) vs web-checkout-products.json. Any missing nest banners must be synced before freeze-6.
